title: NavigationConfig
description: App-level navigation configuration. Mirrors the engine NavigationConfig (core/app.ts). Stored as JSONB in apps.navigation_config. Controls how flows are presented to the user: tab bar, drawer, initial route, and global app state.

initialRoute.description: The route the app navigates to on launch (e.g. '/home').

tabs.description: Tab definitions for bottom tab navigation. If non-empty, the SDK builds a StatefulShellRoute with persistent tab state.

drawerItems.description: Drawer menu items. Routes listed here are accessible via the side drawer.

initialAppState.description: Initial app-level state seeded into the SDK's ElmStore on launch. Keys become available to all pages via V.appState().

forceUpdate.description: When true, the SDK forces all clients to re-fetch config on next launch.

tabBar.description: Custom server-driven tab bar widget tree. If omitted, the SDK renders a default BottomNavigationBar from the tabs array.

drawer.description: Custom server-driven drawer widget tree. If omitted, the SDK renders a default Drawer from drawerItems.

label.description: Tab label displayed in the tab bar.

icon.description: Material icon name for the tab.

initialRoute.description: Route to navigate to when this tab is selected (e.g. '/home').

route.description: Route to navigate to when tapped.
